text:
Good grief; I'm glad we can stay in here to dine! We have our regular seats at the bar for $.60 wing nite and are washing the whole mess down with their ubiquitous 1933 lager draft.  Pete was our dear host  when we arrived. A delightfully simple man whose son Ryan also works here; truly good souls!

Anyway, we started out with the fried portobello appetizer. Smashing food as always; especially with their homemade pub sauce. Wash that stuff down with 1933 and we are batting a thousand. Oh, well:'I'm not reason so for the math, here. Call NASA or MIT, if you must.

Anyway: she totally LOVES the blackened wings: all flappers on request. She could not identify the spice mix but she absolutely loved it! 

Anyhow: QB got blackened wings and I the Pub Roast Beef sammich. She has been wanting blackened wings for a bit of a time, now. Good thing we showed up here!  I tried one; tastes like seasoning salt and cayenne powder, onion and garlic powder. Oh, well; she liked it.

My pub roast beef sandwich had said meat, along with grilled onion, provolone  on a roll alongside a little dish of au jus. The latter seemed a bit salty at first but after a few sandwich dunks: woo! House made fries were a perfect foil...I asked for no salt or seasoning, and that's how it came out. A bit underdone but still yummy. 

Basic byword here is that I'm glad Keith, Julie and our boy Pete have come through this mess with their family and rest of the staff. Keep it up, folks. You're a great asset to the neig

I agree with the 2 star rating, i have been to this one several times over the year and have noticed a decline in service/quantity/presentation/drive through. This was one for kung pao but will say that Reno residents always find the best of the best...i will move on..i expected better and after today when ordering cream cheese ragoon i asked for sweet and sour sauce and with what was rushed out the window was again poor service all the way around. I attached photo with receipt a long with contacting via email.

Placed an online order and arrived at time that it said my order would be ready. Got there and the order was not ready, still has to wait another 10 minutes. The manager was the one I interacted with and she was rude. Acted as though my order was an inconvenience

Placed an order and was told it would be on its way.  There wasn't a way to track it - I asked if there was an eta of when it may leave (10 minutes or an hour?) and was told "no I'm not in the store and I just am the operator for the drivers" 

There should be some type of accountability as to when the food should leave the store and when I should expect it.

The baked cheese was so delicious ( very heavy ) but worth it. I loved the Mac and cheese I added the hot chicken. The hot chicken was very dry almost seemed over cooked. I loved the spicy taste but since the chicken was over cooked I feel Like the dish was lacking. Sandwich was okay nothing out of this world.

I usually read the reviews before I try a place. Of course, I did that here too, and the one comment I keyed in on was that it didn't taste like the Indian food he was used to. Well, I was talking to a friend of mine on Skype the other day who likes in Kolkata (Calcutta for you older folk) and the comment was of course it doesn't! India is a huge country. Northern Indian food tastes much different than Southern. Punjabi Indian food, of which this is a very good representation, is different too; it is Nothern India, but also includes elements of East Pakistan this is part of the historical Punjab region. 
Now on to the food! I went to a few of the lunch buffets. They are a great way to experience the variety of food at Bombay Grill. After the first time, I already had my favorites---the Lamb Vindaloo, a meaty curried stew with big chunks of lamb, the Vegetable Pakoras, a medley of fried veggies such as onion, potatoes, spinach and cauliflower, batter fried and served with either a red or green chutney. The delicate crunch of the veggies is really great! And this, like many dishes on the menu, is labeled there as vegan and vegetarian friendly. 
Chicken Tikka Masala has a nice kick to it but is not too spicy. You can always spice it up more with the chutney. The naan was fresh and tore nicely to sop up the sauce from the chicken. Finally, the Gulab Aman were little balls of sweet heaven, a perfect dessert for the end of the meal. 
The buffet was wonderful at the Bombay Grill. Ne

It was simply amazing  I should have a picture but ummm .. it was devoured ‍‍
Everything is fresh! 
Hubby ate the Kicker and I had the Mango Burger with added Bacon! GEEZ- LA- WEEZ!! *Dancing and Singing* Don't Rush, Take your time with it

I came here over the weekend with my Mom for lunch. First I want to say that the people who work here are so kind. The host was incredibly personable and responsive. Second, the food menu is underrated. I think most people think this place is strictly a coffee shop... it's not! They're breakfast/brunch/lunch menus are filled with healthy and hearty options. The food is beautifully presented and tastes very fresh. Third, the coffee is excellent. I l think I had the best almond milk latte I've had yet here. 

I can't wait to go back! I'll definitely bring my boyfriend here this weekend.
Love this place for breakfast! The orange juice is my favorite with the Tri-Fecta! When family visits we always go here!

I cannot tell you how many times we have been to the Lucky dill we moved recently to Sarasota from Newport Ritchie and every time we visit Newport Ritchie we find ourselves calling for takeout and bringing food home from Lucky dill if we don't stop in and enjoy a bite inside their deli is amazing their bakery is beyond words 
Ever since the COVID-19 pandemic we haven't been inside the restaurant but to order takeout even though they usually have a case full of bakery items when I was there last week I counted and they still have at least 35 different pies pastries cakes to choose from their selection is amazing and their food is impeccable the staff is always pleasant they're knowledgeable and the restaurant is always clean for being such a large place they keep it extremely clean and that is very impressive for me we can't say enough good things about the Lucky dill if you haven't stopped in and you love a good Brooklyn deli and bakery you're absolutely missing out

Give this place a try and you won't be sorry

I'm giving four stars based solely on the service we received. (The food was mediocre but what you'd expect from IHOP). We came in for breakfast and it seemed like there was only one person working. I think her name was Amber. She immediately greeted us and seated us. She was very attentive and brought our drinks and food quickly despite the fact that she had a whole dining room of other people to wait on. AND she was polite and smiling the whole time!

Iron Abbey has a great space and decor in addition to an extensive drink list. The food is overall decent and maybe slightly overpriced when it comes to the entrees. My coworkers and I ordered the ribs, salmon, and fish & chips. The ribs were a little burnt and didn't have a lot of meat on them, the salmon was over cooked, and the fish & chips weren't very crispy. That said, the food was still alright so we enjoyed ourselves. There might be better things on the menu but we haven't had a chance to try everything but this gastropub definitely has potential. At the very minimum, it's a cool space that all visitors will enjoy.
Always delicious and friendly. Quick breakfast burrito drive through! Eat here, you won't be disappointed.

Everything about this restaurant is incredible. The ambiance, the cocktails, the dinner, the service. I couldn't get here fast enough to leave a review. My partner and I came for date night. My parnter is a chef and he was as impressed as I was. We got the Bistro Steak and Seared Salmonn with the Fritto Misto as an appetizer.

This is our second time visiting Noble Crust - our first visit left us craving more. Unfortunately this visit was a far different experience. We ordered the Crispy Shrimp + Calamari (EXCELLENT - it was our first time as a family and everybody was satisfied!!), "New" Crispy Brussel Sprouts, Pepperoni & banana pepper pizza and the Noble Pig pizza.

The Brussel Sprouts were mediocre - no where near the scrumptious appetizer we experienced last year.

Both pizzas were undercooked - the center of the pizza was soggy.

Our previous visit the site was very busy, the waiter was very attentive and the food was all cooked to perfection.

This visit it was not busy, the waitress was nice and the food was... not one I will make a special trip to return...

Great take out & curbside service during COVID-19
Superior food packaging. Thank you for being open on Easter!  We ordered an Easter dinner with appetizers, Beef Wellington, Scalloped Potatoes, Salad, & Dessert.
Exquisite! Food was as tasty as our dine in experiences have been. Appreciate this locally owned gem!
Charging 5 dollar cover on Sunday night. Bathrooms were messy and drink overpriced. Service was standard at best. Will not be coming back.

My husband and I eat Pat's Select about once a week and have never been disappointed! Great food always fresh, very good delivery service too.
Love their flatbreads and my personal favorite the tuna bowl! Delicious!

This place checks out as a reliable go to for pizza & wings in Vail.. I highly recommend the garlic parmesan wings, which is my usual go to but tonight we tried the lemon pepper parm and hot and those too were a hit as well! Personally I really like their chef salad with their balsamic dressing. I've yet to venture out and try some of their different varieties of pizzas and usually go for the pepperoni but you can expect nice sized pieces and nice sized portions in general at this establishment. The staff is very friendly and although sometimes at peak hours when you're calling in an order and they have to put you on hold, just be patient cause it's totally worth it.

This restaurant is a great find. The food is delicious and there is a great variety of dishes. Our favorites are the Bourbon shirt ribs and the scallion pancakes. The owners are friendly and welcoming. It's become one of our regular hot spots!
I love love love  this place! The service is amazing and the food is BOM! You get a great size portion of food and the price is very affordable! By far the best Mexican food in New Orleans!

Tried the unlimited 4 course meal and what a disappointment. I would recommend going elsewhere if our experience was any indication of how things are run.

We had a reservation booked but didn't get to our table for 45 minutes after (other people in the waiting area said that this happens often - if so, why take reservations at all? Or, if you do take them, why don't you fix your system??) Once seated, it took another 15 minutes before our server came to the table. 

For $45 or $49, depending on your entree choice, you were supposed to get unlimited everything (cheese, entree, dessert). Our server said we got 1 cheese, unlimited dippers (bread, raw veg), 1 soup or salad per person, 1 method of cooking and unlimited of your entree choice, and 1 chocolate. Far cry from the "unlimited feast" the advertisements were touting. 

Course 1 - 2 choices of cheese were listed plus a feature cheese for St Patrick's Day. They were out of everything except Wisconsin cheddar...so it wasn't really a choice. It was prepared at the table and it was good (or maybe by then I was so hungry that you could have given me a pot of Cheez Whiz and I would have eaten it) The bread was soft and the few vegetables were fine. Our server was in a rush though, because she took our pot away before we were finished with it so she could get the entree pot going. :(

Course 2 - Caesar salad was soggy and limp. The soup was cold. Not unlimited.

Course 3 - We paid an extra $7.50 to upgrade to the Mojo flavour bro

I came to Lemmon's with my Mom and my toddler to knock another restaurant off the top 100 list I've been making my way through. We both got cocktails which were delicious. It was hard to choose as every cocktail on the menu sounded delicious. We ordered the bread board and crab cake appetizers. I'm pretty sure my toddler ate an entire crab cake herself it was really good. I also loved the Balkan bread with the feta butter I didn't care for the other two spreads as much. For dinner I ordered the sausage flatbread. It didn't have as much flavor as I had hoped but it was tasty. The wait staff was really friendly and had good recommendations. However our waiter also seemed to be covering the bar so it was a little difficult to get his attention but it was early enough in the night it wasn't too terribly busy. Will definitely return!

Beware of online ordering and prepayment. The restaurant didn't answer the phone my wife decided to order online using Eat Street. I was picking up the order on my way back home. When I got there, they told me that someone already picked the order up. There are just 2 people in my house, my wife and I. After confirming with my wife, I told them that nobody from my house had picked up the order but they could care less. They didn't offer to make a fresh order or refund our money, and essentially insinuated with their demeanor that I was  lying. I had to leave empty handed. I had to contact Eat street customer service and they promptly gave us a refund.

My cousins, sisters, and I came for drinks on the rooftop around 8pm on a Friday night. The line was not too long and they did offer seating on the first two floors but we waited for the rooftop which was not too long. It was worth the wait. The music was good. The service was amazing. Our server was so good and the security man Jake was very nice. Such a fun night with my family! Great first time experience!

Me and my girlfriend came here for a nice dinner last Tuesday night (9/3/19). Service was alright, food was amazing. My girlfriend forgot her purse there overnight so we came to pick it up the next day. Sadly enough her whole wallet was missing. She used that same wallet to pay for dinner so we are 100% sure someone from the staff went into her purse and stole her wallet with around $50. Its not possible that we lost the wallet ourselves since we used it to pay for that same dinner. It's really sad that we paid for dinner and tipped well only to have her money stolen. She also works in a restaurant and that cash was her tip money. We will NOT return to a place where workers steal from their own customers and will surely tell our friends about this.

Love Tibby's!!
Everything is delicious!
Love the draft beer in the frozen mug too!
Wings, shrimp and fried green tomatoes are to die for!!
Check it out you won't be disappointed!
Can't wait to go back.
Fantastic place. Always the freshest ingredients and comes out at just the right temperature.

Our first visit to the Coterie and probably our last.  While the food was decent, the service was by far the worse we experienced while having several meals during our trip to New Orleans this week.  Our waiter was inattentive - it took almost 90 minutes for us to get our food.  Other tables near us were also complaining about the poor service.  Since the restaurant was only about 30% full, the poor service was not a result of a crowded restaurant.  Too bad because we'd heard good things about this place, but it didn't live up to our expectations.
Really love this place and great take out and delivery. Great fresh tasting fish, huge portions.
Awesome indoor/outdoor seating, rooftop bar area, beachside. Lots of sand games and the food is decent, what's great about this place is you can drink on the beach

As a group of 7 on a Saturday night with no reservation it was hard to find a table, luckily once we found The Marigny Brasserie we were seated once away. This is a really hard review because the food was five stars hands down. Everyone loved their food, the pasta was able to be made vegetarian, although they also had 2 other vegan items as well. Everyone loved everything that they ordered, and everything we saw coming out of the kitchen looked fantastic. While the food was stellar the service was terrible. Our waiter took about 25 minutes to take our drink order, including bringing us water, our food took over an hour, and our server was completely MIA. While I know that sometimes food for larger groups may take a bit longer, our server never even checked in on us to let us know that it was coming. All in all, I'd say it was great food with poor service.

I've been a customer for over a year and they are consistently good! This is my go-to place during crawfish szn. Upon arrival, you'll place your order, enjoy your food then pay after you eat. My favorite is the viet cajun (butter garlic) flavor and it never disappoints. They use lots of garlic, yumm. I've introduced my friends to this place and they absolutely love it. This place also has a variety of soft drinks and beers to choose from. Staff is attentive and super friendly! Highly recommend!

Hands down the best Indian food in the city. Great customer service, delicious food. I love Indian food and have tried every place in this city, including other places in other states and I am familiar with authentic Indian food. I ordered chicken tikka masala, chicken biryani, Garlic naan, and the daal makhani. Absolutely delicious. Will be coming back for sure.

Supporting our local businesses- Pinocchio's on Virginia St
Firecracker wings- great flavor and really crispy; spaghetti and meatballs- good sauce and nice amount of cheese and their famous big ass salad with house dressing. 
Wonderful meal that will be eaten for a couple of days. Thank you PJ and your friendly staff- great curbside service!! Thank you.

The dream team that is Jeff and Angela of Petite Street...where do we even begin! Jeff and Angela were hands down the best decision we could have possibly made for our wedding. They played a huge role in making our wedding the most incredible day of our lives. From start to finish, they delivered top notch service - from our initial cocktail tasting, to the day of, everything was flawless. The one common theme from all of our friends and family was "Petite Street is amazing! Those cocktails OMG! And that trailer..they built that?! Its so cute! They are so sweet. Can we be friends with them?" They are more than just your typical vendor. They go above and beyond to personally get to know you, and they will work tirelessly to make sure you have the most perfect day.  

When booking Petite Street, Jeff and Angela will have you fill out a cocktail questionnaire to get an idea of what your favorite flavors are when it comes to cocktails. You'll then set up a cocktail tasting with them (we are from San Francisco, and they were extremely flexible when finding a time and date that works for all of us. They even coordinated with our caterer to have everyone in one spot). At the tasting, you'll taste a variety of different cocktails they think you'll like. And let me tell you...we LOVED every single one of them. Picking just two was so difficult! But eventually we decided on a Five Spice Bourbon Punch and Watermelon Mint Spritz, and they were INSANE!

In the months leading up to the wed

No stars, worst pizza I ever had. Greezzy grease is a understatement, the dough was worst than shoe leather, trust me this joint should be ashamed of themselves, the bottom of the box fell out from the all grease, we order 4 pizza threw away 3-1/2. Uh no, on a one bite 1.8

This place was an unexpected treat. I found it on the Find Me GF app. The jerk chicken and plantains are delicious and the portion sizes are very generous. They also have a really nice patio right on the Monon Trail if you want to eat outside.

Great food, definitely the best Chinese in the area. Hot and sour soup is made from scratch every time, and the owner is a fantastic guy.  He is very welcoming and always likes to joke around while delivering  great food at a great value.

Now I know why the monks choose to go into isolation. Sometimes you have something so good, you just need time to yourself lol. I'm actually writing this from a cave in the mountains. Ok, maybe I'm on my couch, in my comfortably air conditioned home...but the sandwich is that good! 

I'm sure there are other great items on the menu but this is all about the duck salad sandwich, a sandwich unlike any I've ever come across. Monk cafe has combined greens, walnuts, craisins, goat cheese, and an absolute gorgeous medium rare duck breast, all inside of an Italian roll. It's creative, it's bold, it's actually quite crazy! Why this work....I don't exactly know, but there aren't many sandwiches I have enjoyed more than this. 

Ok so this being a pub, I hear they have tons of beer on tap, and the mussels are to die for. I did also have the frites(award winning) and can confirm they are as good as advertised, especially that homemade mayo for dipping. All that's nice....but that sandwich though 

Note: if you're not going to go medium rare, just keep in moving. This ain't for you....

This was very disappointing visit. Service was very slow. Sushi was not put together with care. Anything fried tasted like stale bread crumbs. Sushi was a bit mushy. Floors were completely disgusting with food. Servers were polite but very slow.

Excellent, seafood eatery in TUCSON!!!wut wut... 
This place just opened up in Jan and after talking to the chef, yes he emerged from the kitchen to talk to the customer, he is selling out of his menu items.
Menu is clean, simple with a touch of Spanish flare. We ordered guacamole and chips  for $3 (happy hour till 6pm) as well as my strawberry bellini.  I ordered the Branzino Veracruz and the hubs ordered the enchilada banderas... see I told you the "spanish flare"

My dish came out and boy did it appeal to my eyes and yes my stomach took it all in.  I didnt even care  when the server told me it was a sea bass served with the tail still intact...and..???!!!..I cleaned that puppy up! Cascade got nittin' on me.
I did steal a couple of spoonful of rice from the hubs to sop up some of my fish juices...oh man I'm salivating just writing this review!

The Hubs had 3 different enchilada and 3 different sauces made to match the colors of the Mexican flag, red, green and white cream sauce.
As long as we've been married, sharing our food comes natural for us but tonight was different. As I took a sample off his plate, he actually glared at me! That's how good it was, for once he didnt want to share.

I will definitely come back.  It was reasonably priced, great ambiance and patio seating was great.

(One star short of five)
 Although, we did hit a snag on the attentiveness of the hostess. Because we opt to dine al fresco, my husband's chair didnt have a cushion on it and the host said
The service was good but the Cajun pasta tasted like a frozen Devour meal and the queso was like a microwave bag of cheese and meat.

This was my first time trying this and it was a lot of fun! It's not as hard as I thought it would be, I've never golfed a day in my life. We went on a day with half off and for that price I'd do it again. Very good covid restrictions with spread out areas and cleaning in between.

It was the best Mexican food I ever had and I think this restaurant will do very well with every customer that comes in. I didn't have the alcohol since I came alone. However, I wouldn't be surprised if the alcohol drinks were good too. The service is great as well and they have a very friendly staff.

Anticipated to only grab a few beers here and was surprised to see their menu of all the good stuff!!! Burgers, sandwiches, apps, and even salads to go along with your beer! My friend and I ended up spending about 4 hours here talking, eating, and drinking. Highly recommend coming on Wednesday nights at around 8pm for trivia night. The whole place comes together! It's such a fun and laidback atmosphere. The prices of beer and food are beyond reasonable! Great spot!

There are so many diners around, we probably won't be back to this one. Service was great. Eggs on Benedict weren't completely done, nothing great to make anything stand out. Boyfriend said his waffle was fine, nothing special, and that we could go to WH next time.

Was in Nola for 6 days in April and me and my crew of 7 went here every single day. 

Everyone of those days we got a masterpiece of a dog known as the 'Andre'. If you go to dat dog, do not miss the Andre. Also, the outdoor seating was great. We will be back and we will get the andre.

Went here with my friends. Did a waitlist on yelp waited and hour and thirty minutes. Got there only had thirty minutes to wait once checked in . Went in got seated the table was dirty. Our waiter was super sweet and cleaned it off. Ordered drinks, and order of beignets to start. Drinks are pricey, and on the smaller side. Our food came out 30 min later but very cold. I ate my eggs and told the food runner, he becked at me saying "come on" in a frustrating tone to give them back. I give them to him he brings them back hot. I noticed they had the same blackpepper I added to them. Which I knew they were microwaved. My friends food were cold too but they ate because we were tired of waiting. We told our server he immediately went to go get a manager. She came apologized and brought fresh eggs and gave us 20% off.. Still not enough to make us return.
Recommended by a local. Did not disappoint. Delicious crust! Get half and half for only $1 to try two flavors.

This place is fantastic! I ordered the peanut butter and banana toast and if you are a peanut butter lover like me this will surely be one your fav breakfast spots. The wide array of breakfast cream cheeses which are all amazing especially the chocolate cookie dough will keep you continuously coming to try more!

Amazing in every way. Don't miss the bourbon brittle which has a perfect layer of their dark chocolate on top. Caramels with duck fat are 5 Star. They do tours of the factor on Saturday and they will start up again on the 3rd of October. They are happy to give free samples!! Packaging is so cute and plan on buying a tee shirt or hat.

Great food, friendly people, just a slight sticker shock for burger and fries. They have 10 different tasty sauces and 10 different flavored salts. It definitely has a hipster vibe.... they had at least two signs to make people feel like garbage if they want to ask for a straw.  Their food was tasty, so I'll get over it. Also they have an amazing black tea. If you are into iced tea, get it!

I had on order with this restaurant through Uber eats. They sent their own driver. He came without a mask, banged on my door, and demanded a tip. When I called the owner they said that this was ok because apparently 7 years ago when Iived at a prior address, I also didn't tip and he kept records. of it. Stay away from this place.

Tasty crack crab sauce. Service was fast. BYOB!! I would definitely come back again. Great prices and specials. Staff was very nice. Not crowded on a Friday around 6-6:30. Came in and was seated immediately.

Sweetwater is  a local converted diner that has wonderful outside seating with Umbrellas. It is a very safe place to eat and they use excellent precautions. We had the Chicken Pesto Sandwich and the Veggie Flatbread. Both excellent. The service was strong and the waiter wore a mask the whole time. Very much enjoyed our lunch and will return.
Pretty decent cheese and pleasant ambiance to enjoy a light meal.  The cheese has good flavor, a little mild, but it depends on your cheese preferences.

Today was my third visit to Pure Kitchen. Anyone who knows me, knows I love meat. I enjoy Pure Kitchen's food not for the health aspect, but because their meals actually taste delicious! 

The staff at Pure Kitchen are always friendly and helpful. They offer a large variety of meals to please everyone. My favorite is their Mac n' Cheese. The taste is unique because they add nuts to the mix. 

PK is more of a grab and go place. There is minimal seating so if you have COVID concerns, you definitely want to get your meals for take out. 

Pure Kitchen is open 6 days a week and closed on Sundays so plan accordingly if you plan to stop by.

A real disappointment. The Chicken parm was small chunks of overbreaded chicken over a huge pile of mushy pasta with a flavorless sauce. Equally bland garlic bread. 
The smoked turkey club was a better choice . Turkey was ok and the ingredients were fresh. Fries just ok. "Side salad" was limp and mostly pieces of iceberg lettuce, we tossed it. Chicken wings were really just fried chicken wings, although not bad .

I'd pass.

Great food in a fun environment. A new St. Pete favorite.

I was recently in town for a bachelorette party and we had a pretty large group. After a sunset cruise, we decided to have dinner at Red Mesa. It being a Saturday night there was, of course, a pretty significant wait. Luckily there is a cool bar area outside the restaurant where we could relax with drinks and appetizers while we waited. And, surprisingly, our wait time was half what we expected.

I had the Baja fish tacos for dinner. Really good, fresh and flavorful. Fish tacos can be hit or miss but Red Mesa's are great.

Great service started the day with 2 dozen hot extra large crabs.   Brought them to the picnic and quickly we found the well seasoned crabs to be heavy and true to there size.  Great tasting and enjoyed the meeting the team who prepared them 
Thanks for fitting us in at the last moment 
Will return for crabs again without a doubt
Thank you 
Greg

I have always been a Charlie's guy. I might be rethinking it. Right down the street is Zac's. Got a double cheeseburger. It was hot, fresh and larger then Charlie's . Like a lot bigger for a little more then $4.00. I was actually surprised how much I liked it. It's located in an old Arby's from the 70's. Unfortunately I'm old enough to remember that. Nice kids serving and running the counter. It will be a tough call next time I need a Delco cheeseburger.

Solid neighborhood joint - reliable and tasty. Good for brunch or dinner. It's byob as well and there's a beer distributor just down the block. The hanger steak salad is a hidden gem - amazingly cooked and a lot of greens - for those that want a more "healthy" option.

Met a couple friends here for lunch, nice simple menu although a bit expensive appears to be more of a place for dinner as the prices are rather high. I did get the boar sausage pizza which was quite good, The feedback from my entire party was that the food was very delicious.  this restaurant could do better offering some better Lunch specials to draw that crowd and make it more affordable but love the ambience, the space is impressive and a nice environment to eat in.

I went to the Bahama breeze last night and it was wonderful seated within quite literally seconds ( and it was packed so I was very surprised). The waiter was amazing very nice and listened very well. I ordered and recommend the Beef Empanadas they are amazing but I would suggest asking for two servings of sour cream. The food came out also relatively fast which I was surprised about although my mother's salad fit some reason didn't so when the waiter came we had to ask for it and the waiter apologized and got right on it. We got the salad maybe 2 minutes after asking so not great that it didn't come out sooner but at least it was done quickly when we asked for it. Also my mother ordered a ginger al and it tasted like seltzer water so we asked the waiter and he said that something happened with the ginger al and there substituting it but like before as soon as my mother asked for a sprite instead not 1 minute later she had it. The service was a 8/10 ( if only for the mistakes made with the food and drink) the food is easily a 10/10 that includes the drinks ( I had 2 virgin Bahamaritas and they were spectacular) cleanliness 10/10 (No complaints).

The place is so beautiful and pretty, the customer are very kind and the food delicious ! I took the vegan croissant with carrots, beet, mash, cream... but the wrap and toast and muesli looked like delicious too ! Their juice are just very good ( i drank the abc) and the lemon pie was correct. Maybe they are better for the salted :)

Bongo's is located on the beach side, connected to the Grand Plaza hotel. This place gets packed when the weather is nice as it's in a great location. There's always a wedding here too. They have great frozen drinks. I've had the strawberry daiquiris and pina coladas which are both great. The service is really slow when they are busy. Expect to wait a while for your food when it is. We mainly got apps here. The fish tacos were very bland and got mushy pretty fast with the salsa. I needed a ton of hot sauce to make the tacos more flavorful. We also got the fish dip served with crackers, which was very good. The fish tasted fresh and it was decent in size for an appetizer. We also got the buffalo wings, which were pretty meaty and had a good flavor. Overall, fun and lively environment for drinks near the beach.

Excellent food, delicious, all vegetarian, no onions or garlic, easy to digest. I really like the convenience of being able to order on grubhub.
Plenty of parking and good service. I have no idea why there are no diners/customers ever at this restaurant. It is always completely empty, and how do they stay in business? Well, I really like all of their appetizers and the paneer entrees.

Went here last night after going on a ghost tour in old city they didn't have any tables left outside and no indoor seating but I was craving a poboy so we waited. Luckily the waitress was very friendly and accommodating she offered me a beer while we waited which was nice not only that she set us up a table on the sidewalk and charged my phone for me since it died that's what i call service you rock Stephenie We'll be back really soon. Thank you!!!
haven't tried it yet, but it is now open as, Mariscos El Pacifico
Very casual restaurant. I ordered lunch and the service was fast. Nothing fancy at all. I would not take my wife here for a nice meal. But for a Togo lunch it's good. I would eat here again.

For Yelps Big Night In, we ordered take out and they seemed quite busy preparing orders to go. Our meal was very tasty and truly hope they survive during this crazy time. #yelpbignightin #losarroyos #takeout

Fabulous cafe, Shane was amazing and the chicken salad was delicious  If you're in Soulard and want to relax and enjoy great food and the garden area is so relaxing and soothing. I will definitely be back‼
Good and reasonably priced. Waffle and ice cream choice or nothing. Milkshakes were nothing special But they were good.
Pretty much everything we had was great. Fried cheese curds, chorizo and regular corn dogs were delicious but the poutine was just ok.

Great breakfast/lunch today. It was my first visit at this location, but I've been a few times to the Mercer Mall location in NJ.

We arrived at 10:30. There were a number of vacant tables which didn't stay empty too long.

Service was wonderful as was our food. I ordered the Avocado Toast with one fried egg. I asked for the whole grain bread to be well toasted & it was. The whole dish was perfection. My friend ordered the ChopChop Salad & she loved it.

We both ordered coffee following our meal. It was hot and delicious.

I'm happy to say there was a line out the door when we left after a long luxurious meal. I asked our waitress if we should leave & she said stay as long as you'd like. Generally I'm sensitive to a restaurant's need for a table, but today my friend and I had some important things to discuss. We greatly appreciated not being rushed.

I can't wait to go back and have that delicious toast and coffee again very soon.
Great tacos that live up to the reviews. It's too bad that aren't open on Sundays because we miss on when we are passing threw.
High end quality close to 3$ in price best deal ive ever seen in my life soda or battery water or can and hello earth pet friend hi

First of all I have never actually been to either location so I cannot speak to the service or the ambiance. What I can say is that they make pretty good tacos. We have twice ordered The Merman and the Polo Yo tacos for delivery. The whole family loved them and the quality was consistent each time.

During my short day and a half in Tucson, I found Jerry Bob's through Yelp. It was conveniently within walking distance from the airport hotel I was staying at, so I came here for breakfast both mornings I was here.

It definitely is a busy place--almost all the tables were occupied when I came both times, but I didn't have to wait at all for a seat at the countertop. As soon as I sat down, the waitress asked if she could get any drinks started for me. After being handed a much needed coffee, I was presented with a menu. The first day I ordered the Huevos Garcia and the second day I ordered a Denver omelet.

Both days, the food turned out great, and the portions were generous and fairly priced (at least compared to what I'm used to in San Francisco). 

The staff here are efficient, yet friendly. They are constantly zipping around making sure coffees and waters are topped up -- I don't think my coffee ever dropped to below half empty either day. But while they're moving about, they take time to chat and catch up with their regulars and also to check on how everything is going with the meal. 

This restaurant is a bit out of the way from downtown Tucson, but if I'm ever staying by the airport again, I would definitely drop by next time!

Wow did we enjoy this restaurant. Huge parking lot so very easy to park on a busy Saturday night. Extensive wine list, excellent service and delicious food in a stylish industrial vibe atmosphere. I had the chicken piccata and loved it. This place is a fabulous place out for a small or large group. Full bar area too.
Good sake sushi is ok when the owner is not there they fall short must be the kids he puts in charge that cheap it out. LSt time my sashimi smelled it should never do that ever.
Went to find a place to work. Downstairs is louder and busier but upstairs provides for a great area to work. WiFi is open and coffee is great.

Everything I have eaten from here has been good. The ramen with pork is really good. Wish there was a little more spice to the pork or ramen. I am a spicy type person, so it my preference. The broth was very hearty. The Nutella crepe is to die for. I ate it 30 mins after my food and it was cold, and it was still really good. Plan to try some other items.

We have been to other locations all excellent!  We had expressed this to the waiter, and the experience was amazing!!! From Top of the line service, Top Notch Food!! Even management stopped by to talk and made sure everything was above and beyond!! Thank You for making my 60th  birthday FABOULOUS!! Waiter suggested a beautiful wine we ended up with two bottles, because we ordered a lot of food!! We started with Jamon, Manchebo,and Druken Goat cheese! Moved on to Potato Bravas, chorizo in fig wine sauce, Octopus salad!!! And a few other surprises from the house!! I love Barcelona, and was thrilled to find one in Nashville!!

Great place to shop or eat. It's a bit crowded most of the time but that is a testament of how good this place is. The variety of food is staggering, not to mention the wine and cheese room! The deli is always bustling and there is a great assortment of prepared foods to heat up at home. The 2nd building is filled with housewares, trinkets for the kitchen and other goodies. It is a fun place to look around in because you will never know what you will find that you didn't know you needed.

Cute place with a creative all veg menu! We received quick and prompt service. Our server was attentive and receptive to our suggestions. The best part was the price. Veg food shouldn't break the bank and Milo offered some affordable options that left us feeling satisfied without breaking the bank. Will definitely be returning soon.

Absolutely loved this place! Ambiance was amazing. Has the perfect aesthetic and instagramability. Felt safe during covid, and there was minimal interaction with others because you order from your phone. The bubble tea cake was one of the most unique desserts I've ever tried, and it was definitely worth it. Not to mention it makes for cool pictures and videos. Bubble tea was also awesome.

Amico's is delicious NY pizza in the heart of Nolensville. Go in for a pizza or order through them directly. The pizza is always worth the price (& they have great coupons on their website) and always fresh. It's the closest we have to traditional NY pizza south of Nashville.

I love the traditional pepperoni! I don't recommend the garlic knots anymore, as they always come out tough. The slices are pretty greasy too but, hey, it's pizza!

The coustomer service at this restaurant is appalling if you order food and they don't give you all the items that are listed good luck getting a refund or your money back or store credit or any sort of thing the only thing I got was the managers arguing with me and amongst themselves employees who had no clue what was going on where their managers were or how to fix the problem and then instead of having any of my problems fixed I had a 20-minute wait on the phone on hold waiting for a manager to talk to me by the way this is the fourth time I had called in on the fourth day after the incident I called in every day since the incident and he told me that because I did not call right back in when their hours listed online said they were closed therefore I was not able to get my refund they also said that I needed to bring back the food from 4 days ago I'm just saying don't risk it I would avoid this place as if it were the plague if I could give it 0 stars i would

first time in and the pizzas were solid! they didn't feel incredibly greasy like most pizzas and the ingredients were fresh/plentiful. we picked up the order ourselves and it was finished in a timely manner and still hot from the oven. no complaints.

Heard a lot about this restaurant from family that lives close by.  They recommended the Shrimp PO Boy sandwich which is fried shrimp on a hefty French bread.  And the remoulade sauce that comes with the sandwich is no joke, smother that sandwich with as much tangy sauce as you can.  If you're craving Cajun food, this is a must get.  
The jambalaya was good, nothing extra special but tasty.  Good amount of sausage with well seasoned rice.  

Staff very accommodating and follow Covid safety restrictions.

So excited BRIO is back in business! Stopped there while in town, used to go the Brio in NY, we went early dinner Sunday, even though it looked very busy it was a great experience since you walk in, the hosts are very helpful and attentive, the service was quick but never felt rushed and our server Adriana really made a great job guiding us through the menu even the manager Grace stopped to check on us a couple of times! drinks came fast and food was fresh made and perfectly cooked. We love the warm bread and our favorite app the shrimp and eggplant was perfect! 

The place and the decoration Looks nice like always with all the extra precautionary measures in this pandemic we felt save and we could see they care about their guest. Good job ! And we hope they reopen the brio in NY with same service and quality like this one!

Food was pretty good, but I did not enjoy the experience. With so many pizza places available, I don't think that I will be returning. The atmosphere was dull, wait staff seemed either bored or inexperienced, and I'm not sure if they have management around.

Good Pad Kee Mow, will order again. I tried spice level 3 (out of 7), which was less spicy than the medium option at some other Thai places - I'll try 4 next time. The ginger curry was good but not my favorite.
Best quesadilla in town! Quality food and speedy service. Highly recommend if you're in the area!

I was looking forward to celebrating my birthday on 3/6/20 at 10:00 pm at the Nashville location during my visit to the city from Florida. Unfortunately my visit to the restaurant was such a disappointment. The hostess and manager truly need some additional training to sharpen their customer service skills. I had reserved the Top Golf room and upon my arrival i was made aware that they would not be able to accommodate my reservation because someone had arrived prior to me and taken it. Hence they dampened my birthday experience. Furthermore, when serving our water it was murky and seemed to be dirty. When asked of the server as to why the water had that appearance she simply stated that is how all their water looks with a bothered attitude. Next when our entrees arrived the mushrooms part of the steak and frites dish were still frozen.  We requested that our waiter ask the manager to come over to the table so that we could speak to her once again and she never came to the table even upon our request. If asked, I would never recommend this restaurant. I hope that this review will be taken into consideration in uptraining your employees to better service customers.

Let me start by saying this - there aren't enough full service, sit-down Chinese restaurants anymore.   Most of them have gone the pure takeout route and that's a shame.  Its nice to find places like Lotus Garden  that still offer that experience.

The menu is pretty similar to most Americanized Chinese restaurants  but I liked the fact that they seemed to be using fresh ingredients instead of the standard processed stuff that comes loaded up with preservatives.    I just got basic Mongolian Chicken with some tea and Hour-Sour soup.     Everything was great - maybe even a little better than your average, neighborhood spot.   But the thing that took it over the top was the cool atmosphere and great service.   

I would be a regular if I lived nearby
Great pizza and tea at good prices.  What more can you ask for?

Omg the best fried chicken in the whole wide world and their bread pudding was amazing!!! 

It's a small local restaurant where most customers inside seemed to be locals. Our uber driver wasn't sure why we're heading to this dark strip mall because that's the only thing that was opened in this area next to the freeway. By the way, our uber driver had a hard time finding this place so just be prepared.

Their fried chicken batter was so crispy and light. The chicken was juicy and well flavored. They put other fried chicken places to shame. We also tried other dishes like gumbo but their fried chicken was definitely the spotlight. And their bread pudding was out of this world. I'm never a fan of this dessert but they made it so well I would eat it again. 

It's funny this was our first stop after our flight into New Orleans and the waitress said "well, I hate to say this but this might be the best meal of your stay and you'll want to come back a second time." And dam she's right. Lol.
above & beyond. the chef was hyper- accommodating. excellent experience & delicious food

1st time dining here. Had heard good things. Just stopped in for a quick brunch with my bestie. Place was smaller than I thought, so you can imagine that Sunday brunch was a popular time. All of the dishes passing by my table looked phenomenal and definitely had me wanting to plan another visit to try other items. Today, however, I settled on the Nashville Hot Chicken Biscuit with fries (could have had a salad but hey, I wanted all the fatness today). I also added their cheddar bacon sausage patty. The star of this meal was the sausage patty. It was juicy with a little spicy kick. The biscuit was also good. Thick enough to withstand the weight of the breaded chicken breast and slaw, but not dry. The fries were a tad too salty, but we're golden brown and crispy. I only wished there was more of a seasoning on the chicken breast. Maybe the slaw, pickles and ranch sauce were supposed to make up for the lack of taste with the chicken, but I think a little seasoning would have taken this sandwich over the top. I definitely recommend a visit, make sure to make a reservation if you go for brunch. Can't wait to explore the rest of the menu. Oh, and if you are an eggs and meat person, might I suggest the Ohio Truck Stop dish. Eggs, bacon, hasbrowns, ham, that delicious cheddar bacon sausage, and brioche toast. Yum!

Sad to say that my boyfriend and I had a terrible experience here on Valentine's Day 2021. We made our reservation at La Fontana because we actually had 2 of our anniversary dinners here in the past and had a wonderful time. Before making the reservation, I noticed that the restaurant had some bad reviews, but decided to give the benefit of the doubt because we had good memories here. And boy did that turn out to be a mistake. First of all, they did not have the normal menu available and instead everyone was forced to order a $60 4-course Valentine's Day menu. Nobody at the restaurant mentioned this change to me when I made the reservation, nor was there any indication of this once we got there before sitting down. I do understand that many restaurants do this on Valentine's Day though so I was willing to let it slide....if the experience was good. This brings me to the start of the problem. Every course came after a HUGE delay. We were there for TWO HOURS before our entrees even got to us. TWO HOURS. And when the food did come it was a huge disappointment...

The first course came for which my boyfriend and I both opted for the soup - Pasta e fagioli. When the soup came...I don't even know how to describe it. There was NO pasta, only beans! And the soup was the strangest color (instead of red it was orange and looked buttery? oily?) In any case, it looked pretty disgusting, and it tasted even worse -- like slightly salty water? There was not even any flavor of tomato or any

Amazing ! From pizza to cheesesteaks to hoagies and everything in between ! Great beer selection as well ! Maria is great she keeps the place extremely clean and always has a smile ! This is your destination point in Ardmore , highly recommend !

My friend and I were on the hunt for some delicious Puerto Rican food before going to Busch Gardens and we happened to stumble across La Bahia! We both got the Media Noche and it was absolutely delicious. We got some croquetas that we weren't really a fan of but we would definitely be back to try the rest of the menu!

After you see this place enough in your Korean dramas, you got to be a little curious how good these fried chicken must be. Are they acting and pretending to crunch into those tasty looking chicken for the advertisement? Well I have to try for myself.

I have to admit not the biggest fan of the original olive thingy, I rather go to KFC or Popeyes for that. But what got me is the soy garlic, that to me represents real Korean style fried chicken. They marinated so well and yet so crispy. Amazing! Pricing is around the same for a lot of other fried chicken places. 

What I like about this franchise is the additional foodstuffs you can order so it isn't just about the chicken.

Hours say open till 2am but closed at 1:08am. "Manager" says closed because she wants to go home early and she makes the rules. Fucking pathetic when you work nights and rely on these mouth breathers to be open once in awhile.

Drink menu is great and I love that they have so many vegetarian options. Unfortunately, not a lot of gluten free options that are also vegetarian. I got the Kale Quinoa Salad and the quinoa on it was not cooked. I asked the waitress about it and after checking with the kitchen they told her that was how it was supposed to be prepared. So I definitely wouldn't recommend that entree salad.

So my family decided to have a day off downtown for some scooter riding and my wife saw a New Mexican restaurant close by she wanted to try. So we gave it a shot, on arrival we was sat pretty quick it took our server a while to come take our order, I was very surprised on how fast the food came out after we ordered very impressed. Everyone loved their food, my wife had a margarita she said it was ok. We usually go to El Borro Loco in the CWE and we both like that location better. After reading the reviews here at La Bamba I was a bit nervous cause they wasn't so good but after our visit it wasn't bad, also my wife went to the bathroom and was very upset that only one stall had tissue but it wasn't on the roll it was on the floor and no paper towels either. I would hope the staff would be a little more friendlier as well.

This restaurant is tucked away in the Central West End neighborhood of St. Louis. We ordered at the counter from the friendly server and easily found an open table. Our food arrived quickly. It was fabulous! We had Pad Thai with chicken, Orange Chicken, and Coconut Bubble Tea. We will definitely return!

Awesome pizza! And they just added a burger and a frozen bushwacker to the menu, which ate both really good. Amazing atmosphere! The staff is great! Kid and pet friendly. Lots of outdoor seating on the water. You can get there by car or by boat. And there's plenty of room to dock boats. They also sell fuel for any boaters needing to fill up. Everyone should definitely check it out!

Still delicious & their online ordering from website is finally functional.   Order direct to cut out the steep corporate middleman fees.   Very tasty food & very local.   Note that business hours are reduced due to COVID.  I think maybe 4-8 pm?  Call ahead before ordering.  But definitely check out their own website before online ordering apps like GH or DD.

This was my 2nd time here. First for dinner. The atmosphere was great and decor great. But waited over an hour for our food to arrive, waitress no where to be found after sitting us. 20 minutes before she came back. The DJ was horrible. Ruined every song that he played and it was way too loud. Could barely have a conversation. However the manager did comp the whole meal and gave great customer service. I will be back but if that DJ is there i will immediately walk out

My wife and I have been to Bing Bing about 10 times over the past few years and it has never once disappointed. Consistently excellent food that is bursting with flavor and really sticks to your ribs. I highly recommend this wonderful restaurant.

I really love this place. The pasta is the best! The Veal was a bit over cooked but everything else was so good and I just love it there so much that I don't really care. The pasta is fantastic it's just always a good place to go for a romantic dinner the staff is great. A great addition to our neighborhood in the French quarter I recommend it highly.
Really good! I got the mild green curry & the tofu was fried which I wasn't expecting but over all super good! Definitely recommend & will be going back!

For the appetizers, the focaccia bread is a must. The bread was light and became even more delicious when combined with the rich butter. We also got the snapper cruddo, which was very fresh and light (def recommend if you're into eating sashimi).

I got the doppio ravioli, which was the best decision I made. The plating was beautiful. I enjoyed the mix of the two flavors because paired so well. Also, the pasta was so flavorful yet felt so light because of the fig. 

My bf got the agnolotti, which was super creamy and packed with flavor. Personally, I liked my dish more because it was lighter but if you are into a heavier, more creamy pasta, I'd recommend the agnolotti.

We ended the night with the huckleberry pie which I really enjoyed. If you're into blackberries and more seedy fruit, this is a must. The cream on top of the pie was the perfect touch.

It's a 35 min. drunk to Lee Lee so we go once a month, and every time we go, we pack the car.
We're a mixed family of carnivores and vegetarians and this grocery has it all. They have a fresh butcher counter with (what some might consider) exotic meats. I snap up lots of Tasty Bite Indian veg packets. Also my other half can't get enough Pocky Stix! Plus sacks of a big variety of rice.
But the biggest reason we use up gas is to stock up on the incredible selection of sake and other spirits.
While there check out the asian restaurant in the same strip,. It's always closed when we shop!

Stopped here for the second time since the new owners have taken over and it wasn't a pleasant experience. I ordered at the bar which was a surprise since for food you could order at the kitchen. Three of us coming of a long bike ride were starving and I was so ready for a hot roast beef. 20 minutes later my friends food came and mine didn't, when I asked the waitress she said it was coming. 20 minutes later when the food didn't come I went to cancel and the kitchen was closed so apparently my order was lost somewhere in the process. This is the second time ive been disappointed by the new regime. Sad because this was one of my favorite spots.

Mr Bills has THE best homemade butter pecan ice cream. Love it more than hobbits love po-ta-toes. Hands down the best I've tasted. Homemade veggie burgers when your sick of the factory ones. Staff friendly

Discovered Hen by chance and was blown away. Fresh flavorful food which was a delight to eat. Great prices and portions. We had the Grilled pork, beef vermicelli, the Mi Quang and and order of wings. Every plate was better than the previous. Highly recommend!

Sampan is such a great place to go with friends- it offers more Asian fusion options and some similar items to Double Knot ( which is more Japanese) and has cool interior. I also love the graffiti bar located through a narrow alleyway behind the restaurant which serves amazing scorpion bowls that you can also get inside! If you're really feeling it, try the vodka ginger beer punch bowl- its so good and I've seen anywhere from 2 to 6 people share it haha. Their other cocktails are also really good. Like DK, they also let you do a sample menu, which is a great option for sharing- they give enough for everyone to have a bite or two. My favorites are edamame dumplings, grilled swordfish, hanger steak, brussels sprouts, and these little ice cream cones that come in interesting flavors that change seasonally. This place is always packed but definitely worth it.

I've been wanting to try this spot since I've moved to Tampa. Street parking is free on weekends & we didn't have to walk far to get to the restaurant from our car. This place definitely fills up the later you get there. The service was amazing. I wish I could remember our servers' name but she was extremely welcoming and really attended to us. I ended up ordering the omelette with home fries and toast. For $13 bucks you really can't beat how much food you get. The food was all really tasty I was glad I was able to take the rest home for left overs. You can tell this place has its regulars-- which just shows how good it is. Definitely a gem of Tampa & highly recommend this place to anyone wanting breakfast/brunch.

Delicious. We ordered bento boxes. He got lasagna , i had cannellini 
Came with, salad, appetizer and dessert. Took the dessert home for later. Would def recommend oh, and if you like coffee, it is strong. Very good in my opinion

Nadine's was one of the first places we decided to go out to dinner after quarantine. We were still brand new to our neighborhood and it was only a short walk from our new home. 

We chose Nadine's because they had a fairly diverse menu that seemed to have something to satisfy just about any hankering you make have. We were also just so stir crazy from eating all of our meals inside for months. Their patio looks so large from the street that we figured it would offer us safe social distancing from other patrons. 

Upon arriving we went inside the bar, knowing that we wanted to go to the patio but didn't know the flow since we were newbies. The inside of the bar seems very festive and like a great place to spend a Friday or Saturday night with a big group of rowdy friends. *Sigh* those were the times huh?

We were a bit put off that there really wasn't an employee greeting you or a sign that said wait to be seated. Eventually the bartender took note of our general confusion and barked "What do you boys need?" He said we could take a seat on the patio and a different bartender would help us. He seemed a tad perturbed when we said we wanted to sit outside. 

The patio was like the freaking wild west. There was an old man smoking a cigarette while watering plants. There was a mishmash of tables that were varying shapes, sizes and heights. And there was a crew of what seemed to be regulars belly up to the outdoor bar. The tables were definitely not 6-feet apart, so we did our best

My newest obsession. Barbuzzo. 

Have to admit that I was worried at the onset of my first visit.  Packed into a table on top of each other and touching elbows with people at either side of us, the noise level made it difficult to hear the servers answers to my questions.  My SO gave me a look of apology for making the reservation.  It's ok, no big deal. 
When a dish of charred broccoli arrived, my concerns vanished.  Who cares about the noise and overcrowded space when the food is this wonderful. Well, yeah, I do a little bit but the food is seriously incredible. 
The ingredients aren't exotic, but they are boldly, unapologetically seasoned and beautifully balanced. 
I can vouch for the octopus dish, stuffed meatballs, bronzino, tufoli, burger (lunch) and the pork sandwich (lunch).  
Maybe a little less on the being crammed into a tables on top of each other, and possibly some friendliness on the faces doing the work and this place would be perfect. 
I love it and will be coming back over and over again.

We get delivery through Postmates on the regular and have always been pleased. The Unforgettable sandwich is amazing, even my 5 year old likes it!!!! And they're hard to please! We also get the broccoli cheddar cheese soup which comes with this delightful Parmesan crafted crostini, so yum! And we love that they come with cookies too :)

This place has fabulous food!  My husband and I were out for a walk, not planning on eating out. But the outside table looked inviting so we stopped. We were their FIRST customers. We are ecstatic to have such good food available within walking distance. Tom had lamb chops that were perfectly done. There was a bit of goat cheese served alongside that was delicious as well as nicely done carrots. I had a great filet of redfish with a tasty coating. Alongside both our meals were excellent potatoes separately presented, perfect texture, areas of nice crisp skin, divine and well off my diet! Asparagus wrapped in bacon accompanied the fish.  We met the owner Jesse who had trained at NOCCA, the chef was beaming, and server Anu who was kind and solicitous. We had a lovely outside table. They like our dog. Who could ask for more? We will be back!

We visited Da Blue Lagoon for dinner and it was amazing! I've had Jamaican food from other places in Indy, my opinion is this restaurant is the best! The server was great and the owner Graham was very friendly, they both made sure we were taken care of the entire time! My friend and I both ordered Da Bob Marley frozen daiquiri, it's was delicious and fruity! We also shared the Montego Bay Platter, which was delicious. I loved the coconut shrimp and the beef patty. I ordered the Island Trio for my entree and a side of the fried Plantains, I really enjoyed all of it! My favorite was the Fricassee Chicken, it was a brown chicken stew and it was delicious! We went all out and also tried the Jamaican rum and raisin cheesecake! I would eat dessert for dinner. I can't wait to come back and eat here again! As a tip: the owner said they have live music once a week, make sure to check out their social media for the details!

I'm a huge fan of Caffeina, but almost always go to the Overland location.  This one on State Street is larger, more spacious and has more selections for coffee beans.  This is the best coffee shop in Boise, nothing compares.

I placed  a Togo order. The guy was super friendly over the phone. Once I got there , no one Acknowledged me .. Finally someone  did come and help me., he was nice but not over the top friendly. You could tell he wasn't happy to be working... the pizza was stiff and not good at all. Not worth the price. 
I use to come all the time., probably won't be back for a while .

Our plan for Sunday brunch had been Cafe du Monde. But then we saw the longest line in the world. In swooped Monty's to save the day! We waited about 20 minutes for a table (there's not a lot of room to wait). I ordered the King Cake Beignets which were INCREDIBLE! Filled with a delicious cinnamon cream cheese icing and topped with Mardi Gras sprinkles, they were yummy and filling. The whole table stole some. Everyone else found something they loved as well. Our server was a perfect southern gentleman and everything was served hot and fresh. Would definitely return on our next visit, maybe for a dinner.

Great place. Sat at the bar. Warm out door dining. Impressed at how friendly yet low key the staff was. Really makes the meal great. Tuna bowl was perfect California fare. Highly recommend for excellent casual dining.
Barista Del Barrio was delicious!  My fiancé got the chorizo burrito.  I ordered the quesadilla and it was so tasty.   Would highly recommend.
Love this place for brunch! The service staff is phenomenal and the food is fantastic.

This place was all around great! To find a place that's open is hard but to find a yummy place that was open was awesome! The service was fantastic first and foremost! We had the bbq shrimp appetizer- super messy and sooooo worth it! The shrimp and grits was super tasty!! We will definitely come back if in New Orleans again!!
My go-to place for brunch or breakfast! As a French toast lover, I love getting the French toast platter with sausages and bacon!

Yes, I'm a hot head. Give me anything slathered with a spicy, flavorful sauce and I'm going to love it. So naturally Indian food is my number one take out choice. And let me tell you, India Rasoi delivers on all fronts each and every time. From the delicious and authentic vegetarian dishes to my new personal favorite dish, the Kerala Fish Curry (think creamy coconut curry with lots of fresh fish and packed with an insane amount of spice and flavor you'll swear you're in southern India) I've never been disappointed with my order. And the Samosas... might be my favorite appetizer EVER. I also love how every time I order my curries extra spicy they never skimp on the spice. I can handle just about any heat level, so it doesn't take a lot of skimping on the spice for me to notice upon first bite, but man do they deliver with the heat. Something you really don't see a lot with ethnic restaurants in the city attempting to cater to most American tastes. I definitely appreciate it when my spice level is exactly where I ask it to be, so that's reason enough for me to keep ordering here. Thank you Rasoi for making my quarantine evenings filled with flavor, and one of these days I look forward to stopping by and dining in person for once!

I've been here before and the food is good but this experience was terrible. I ordered a simple chicken Katsu bowl, the cashier said it would be 5 min but I showed back up in 10 min to give it a little extra time. It still wasn't ready but it wasn't a big deal, I'm a pretty patient person. I walked back over 3-4 diff times in 5 min intervals to see if the food was ready, it still wasn't. 

I had 8+ people order behind me and EVERY SINGLE ONE OF THEM got their food before me. I walked back up after about 20 min and they JUST started making my order. I was fed up and told them to not even worry about it and give me a refund. Instead of apologizing and possibly just comping my order, the cashier just said "oh the order got lost, we got busy." That's a terrible excuse when EVERY OTHER PERSON GOT THEIR ORDER and no one else's got "lost". 

I'm in customer service and it's very sad to see the service industry doesn't know how to hire ppl that know how to deal with ppl. I got no apology. No offer to comp my meal. The cooks were laughing at the matter. Will never spend my money at this place again. 

I understand that places get busy, but the customer service was terrible.

I've avoided visiting WOB in the past because I'm not a beer drinker. I was surprised when I found out that they have a Sunday brunch.

I was there with a group of ladies and had a great time! The menu options were great. I believe everyone enjoyed their meals. The option of bottomless mimosas, "beermosas", and bloody Marys was a plus. They were able to accommodate our large group on the patio, the prices were reasonable, and the service was great.

I still don't drink beer, but I won't avoid them anymore!

I first came to know of Tequilas in the late 80's.
David the owner was most gracious every time I stopped for dinner.
I left Philly for some time and didn't know they moved to their current location. 
When I returned to the Area, I found them again.
I re-introduced myself to David and as if nothing had changed other than the location. The food, service and hospitality was incredible. 
Always good to know that nothing changes and I can count on the fact that it is one of the finest restaurants in Philly. 
If your looking for a great experience, go to Tequilas...

Love everything about this place, quality of food, service and people! If you're in the Franklin-Cool Springs area - you must check out to have a dinner...or lunch...all sooo good! Great atmosphere and take out!

Stopped by for lunch on a Thursday in August. Outdoor seating was good, lots of space between tables, servers wore masks...all Covid happy! We had drinks and lunch. I had The Paloma cocktail which was delicious, very fresh and light, perfect summer drink. For lunch I had the Tomato Caprese salad which was very nice. Tomato, mozzarella, eggplant stacked next to an arugula mix.  Very nice plate for a summer lunch. Service was good.  The rest of my party had lobster bisque, Caesar salad and the pierogies - everyone left happy!  Support local restaurants and Cinder Bar is one you should try!

Good little Chinese food stop. I usually get Chinese takeout when I'm on business trips. I don't know why, must be a habit! The beef and broccoli was very good. Good amount of meat and vegetables were still crunchy and flavorful. The generals chicken was a bit chewy but then again I came in at eight 8 PM, an hour before closing. It had a nice flavor with mild spiciness. As you can tell from the pictures, there were good portions for each dish. The eggrolls were hot, good-sized and flavorful as well. Got my order to go and the service was pleasant and quick.

My friend and I went to eat at Tucanos on Saturday 10/19/2919 for my birthday. The ambiance was fun and we had a good time. Because the lighting was low I was unable to see that I was eating half raw food!!!! I became Violently sick from food poisoning and have been suffering for 4 days now. Do not eat there!!!

Second Street is closed for the businesses during the weekend and now that the weather is cooler eating outside was great.     I ordered the Guinness stew and I'll be back for that.     Great staff and drinks too!
Alwas hearty sized portions, treat my son and I as if we sre VIPs, and if there ever has been an issue, they resolved it immediately.

Very charming, cozy village - was totally surprised at how it was laid out.  Felt almost like walking through a childhood fairytale book.  Cobblestone walkway path, beautifully manicured floral designs and landscape, lovely layout of stores.  Would be nice if it was bigger but really great place to stop by and take a nice stroll.  They also have very nice antique / themed stores and a place for children to enjoy towards one of the entrances.

Pros : magical layout, beautifully designed, cozy and lovely walkways

Cons : some of the parking is 30 mins, layout is a bit odd ( some stores, would estimate about 25% are on the outside.  Also the bathrooms are really weird ( depending on how you put your hand by the sink - it drops soap, then water then air dry all in one -- you'll understand once you use the stalls ).

Overall : Awesome, worth a look!
Hands down best Poboys in town!! I've be to NOLA twice and this was must stop the second time around

Bland, subpar food. I've ordered maybe five sizable orders from them over the past few months, as I live nearby. Different stuff every time. Every time it's been consistently unflavorful and unsatisfying. The only good thing I had was a cup of wonton soup. I think people come mostly for the dimsum, which I haven't been able to try as you have to sit inside for it. Also, the absolute worst potstickers I've ever tried. Incredibly thick-skinned and greasy too-salty lumps of meat inside. Maybe go for the wontons instead.
